_about: Lists whose row count differs from a count printed in the text, each read on the list itself (27 Oct 2026). Both readings and the finder agree on the rows in every case; the differences are in what the printed sentence counts.
1880_2: 40 rows numbered 81-120 against 'thirty-eight stations'; Skerryvore and Hynish Signal Tower take two numbers (93, 94), and the count in the sentence is the print's.
1881_0: 27 rows against 'twenty-six stations, as before': the list adds Fair Isle as 7B, and its own note says so.
1881_2: 40 rows numbered 81-120 against 'thirty-eight stations, the same number as in 1880': the same 40 rows as the 1880 list.
1882_0: 27 rows against 'thirty stations on the East Coast of Scotland, Faroe, and Iceland': the list prints no rows for Iceland or Faroe (numbers 1-3 on the master list).
1882_1: 37 rows against 'thirty-six ... and two stations on the Channel Islands,--thirty-eight altogether': the list prints 35 English stations and the 2 Channel Islands lights, one fewer than the sentence.
1885_1: 28 rows against 'twenty-seven stations': the list adds Carr Rock (26B) and Fidra (27B), marked as new stations for 1885-86.
1885_3: 36 rows against 'forty-five stations': the list prints 36; the sentence's count is not explained on the page.
1885_4: 35 rows against 'thirty-four stations, not including the Isle of Man': the list adds 109B Ailsa Craig (building).
1885_6: 39 rows against '34 schedules sent out' (schedules per season, not stations): numbers 1-40 with 5* and 8* added and 9, 35, 36 absent.
